feed.title: Pravesh Singh — Engineering Essays
feed.subtitle: Technical essays on healthcare software architecture, PostgreSQL multi-tenancy, ABDM integration, inventory ledgers, applied AI, and DPDP compliance by Pravesh Singh (Founder & CTO, SoftEdge Technology Solutions).

entry.title: Architecting Offline-Tolerant Software for Indian District Hospitals
entry.summary: Offline-tolerant hospital software treats the device's local SQLite or IndexedDB store as the primary write path, committing every clinical action in under 15 milliseconds. Conflicts resolve per domain — immutable clinical events, column-level CRDTs, double-entry inventory ledgers — while batch sync with idempotency keys absorbs reconnection floods.

entry.title: ABDM Integration: A Pragmatic Engineering Guide for HealthTech Developers
entry.summary: Wire your hospital system into India's ABDM gateway as a HIP or HIU. Every gateway call is asynchronous: HTTP 202, then a signed /v0.5/ webhook callback. Production readiness spans ABHA verification (M1), care-context linking (M2), and consent-driven FHIR R4 exchange encrypted with ECDH (M3).

entry.title: Multi-Tenant Database Isolation in PostgreSQL: Schemas vs Row-Level Security
entry.summary: Shared-schema Row-Level Security (RLS) scales better than schema-per-tenant for B2B SaaS: one migration, normal PgBouncer transaction pooling, per-row tenant isolation via session-scoped tenant_id policies. Schema-per-tenant suits fewer than ~100 high-compliance enterprise customers.

entry.title: Double-Entry Inventory Ledgers for High-Value Cold-Chain Medicines
entry.summary: Every stock movement of Factor VIII/IX becomes a balanced debit/credit journal entry; on-hand quantity is a derived SUM, never a mutable counter. PostgreSQL FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED enforces FEFO allocation under concurrency, and the ledger survives regulatory audits with zero phantom stock.

entry.title: Structured Data Extraction with LLMs: Pushing Beyond Prompt Engineering
entry.summary: Naive prompting fails enterprise extraction on schema drift, hallucinated fields, arithmetic errors, and provenance. The production answer: schema-constrained decoding, Pydantic invariant validation, targeted delta-retry loops, and bounding-box citation anchoring — achieving >99.4% field-level precision.

entry.title: DPDP Act 2023: An Engineering Architecture Checklist for HealthTech Platforms
entry.summary: The DPDP Act 2023 grants patients a Right to Erasure while medical statutes mandate retention. The 10-point engineering checklist covers consent-manager state machines, purpose-limitation schemas, cryptographic scrubbing, fiduciary access controls, and immutable audit logs.
